items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Put a Lucky Roberts piano roll on, Peter Wedling.

ctx.x: And they didn't have any piano players, but they had the pianolas. Put a Lucky Roberts piano roll on, Peter Wedling. And some of the other fellows that had made rolls for the piano roll companies. And then you set there and drink. Because it was prohibition. And they would serve you the liquor in a pitcher and a cup, like you was having tea. And you'd sit there and drink and you'd meet a little lady friend and all like that, see. And they had at the Buffet Flat, it was more like a
motel. They had rooms for you if you got that far.
